name: RENO
summary: RENO measured reactor-antineutrino disappearance at Hanbit with near and far scintillator detectors. It independently established nonzero theta13 and measured the oscillation amplitude, frequency and reactor spectrum over a long campaign.
detection_principle: Matched gadolinium-loaded scintillator detectors identify inverse beta decay. The far-to-near spectral comparison cancels common flux uncertainties and resolves energy-dependent disappearance.
